RIVEN:

Use the provided Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Riven must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

Riven is an adult and a highly skilled swordswoman.

Keep her original costume, hairstyle, body proportions, and sword unchanged.

FATHER:

Use the provided Father reference image as the strict primary visual reference for Riven's father.

Preserve his recognizable facial appearance, age, hairstyle, facial hair, body proportions, clothing design, and grounded former-warrior appearance.

He is an experienced former warrior and a highly skilled swordsman.

Keep his appearance consistent throughout the entire video.

He remains calm, precise, and controlled.


=== CHARACTER COUNT — STRICT ===

There are exactly TWO human characters in this entire scene:

1. Riven.
2. Riven's father.

No other person appears.

No soldier appears.

No enemy appears.

No creature appears.

No monster appears.

No animal appears.

No additional combatant appears.

Riven and Father interact ONLY with each other.

They are father and daughter.

They are NOT enemies.

This is controlled sword training.

Neither character is trying to injure or kill the other.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided village/home reference as the environmental reference.

The entire scene takes place in the familiar dirt-and-grass training yard beside Riven's family cottage.

Weathered timber-and-stone cottage.

Stacked firewood.

Chopping block.

Wooden fence.

Large old tree.

Green valley and rugged mountains beyond the village.

Natural afternoon daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

Do not change location.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Realistic sword weight and sword contact.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict character identity and costume consistency.

Keep the physical action extremely simple and readable.

There is only ONE disarm action.

No extended sword fight.

No additional combat sequence.

No rapid montage.

No exaggerated acrobatics.

No spinning attacks.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

No glowing weapons.

No injury.

No blood.

All dialogue must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Every written dialogue line must be spoken verbatim by the specified character.

Clear natural English pronunciation.

Accurate visible lip synchronization.

No Chinese or Mandarin.

No Vietnamese.

No Japanese.

No Korean.

No other spoken language.

No additional dialogue.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Open with Riven and Father already standing close together in the training yard.

Their two swords are already pressed against each other in a controlled blade lock.

Do NOT generate the attacks that happened before this position.

Begin directly from the blade lock.

Riven pushes against Father's sword.

Father remains calm.

Father makes one simple controlled movement:

he steps slightly to the side,
redirects Riven's blade,
and uses leverage to remove Riven's sword from her hands.

Riven's sword falls onto the dirt.

CLANG.

The physical action ends immediately.

Father does NOT continue attacking.

Riven is NOT injured.

Riven looks at her fallen sword.

Then she looks at Father.

Riven says:

"I thought I had you."

Father answers:

"You did."

Riven looks slightly puzzled.

Father already understands that Riven has decided to leave home.

He asks:

"When?"

Riven immediately understands the question.

She answers:

"Tomorrow."

Father looks toward Riven's sword on the ground.

Then he looks back at Riven.

Father says:

"Pick it up."

Riven walks to her sword.

She bends down.

She picks it up.

No one speaks again.


=== SHOT 1 — DISARM ===

Begin with a medium shot of Riven and Father.

Both characters are clearly visible.

They are already standing close together.

Riven holds her sword.

Father holds his sword.

Exactly two swords are present.

The two blades are already pressed against each other.

Do not show an earlier attack.

Do not create a longer fight.

Riven applies controlled pressure against Father's blade.

Father remains balanced.

Father makes one compact movement.

He steps slightly away from Riven's line.

He redirects Riven's sword.

He uses controlled leverage.

Riven loses her grip.

Only Riven's sword leaves her hands.

Father keeps his own sword.

Riven's sword falls onto the dirt.

CLANG.

Immediately stop all combat.

Father lowers his own sword.

Riven remains standing and unharmed.


=== SHOT 2 — WHEN? ===

Riven looks down at her sword lying on the ground.

Then she looks back at Father.

She is mildly frustrated, not angry.

Riven says clearly in English:

"I thought I had you."

Father looks directly at Riven.

Father answers:

"You did."

A quiet pause.

Riven looks slightly confused by his answer.

Father does not explain it.

He studies Riven for a moment.

Then Father asks clearly:

"When?"

Riven immediately understands what he means.

She does not ask for clarification.

She does not explain her decision.

Riven looks directly at Father.

Riven answers:

"Tomorrow."

Father remains calm.

No argument.

No surprise.

No emotional speech.


=== SHOT 3 — PICK IT UP ===

Father briefly looks toward Riven's sword lying on the dirt.

Riven follows his gaze.

Father looks back at her.

Father says clearly:

"Pick it up."

Riven turns toward the sword.

Father remains where he is.

Riven walks to her fallen sword.

She bends down.

Close on Riven's hand reaching toward the grip.

Her hand closes around the sword.

Riven lifts the sword from the dirt.

She straightens while holding it.

Father remains behind her in the training yard.

Riven briefly looks back toward him.

Neither character speaks.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Exactly two characters remain:

Riven and her father.

Both are unharmed.

Father still holds his own sword.

Riven has picked her own sword back up from the ground.

Riven has told Father:

"Tomorrow."

Father understood that she intends to leave.

There was no argument.

There was no goodbye.

Neither character leaves the training yard.

End with Riven standing again with her sword in hand.


=== MOOD ===

Grounded.

Quiet.

Restrained.

Decisive.

The action is intentionally simple:

blade lock
→ Father performs one controlled disarm
→ Riven's sword falls
→ all combat stops
→ "I thought I had you."
→ "You did."
→ "When?"
→ "Tomorrow."
→ "Pick it up."
→ Riven retrieves her sword
→ CUT.

Exactly two people.

Exactly two swords.

No third character.

No army.

No soldier.

No enemy.

No monster.

No creature.

No real battle.

No additional sword exchange.

No departure.

No goodbye.

No location change.、16:9
